ballPolicy: Keeg-specific separate basketball follows his ball-miming hand through the first overhead pump, resets to his chest, rises for the second pump, and releases at frame10/tick21. It is never painted into the poses.

review.reviewNotes: All fifteen authored poses select the registered production atlas in both facings at standard and 120% zoom. Keeg retains his human anatomy, beard, black hair, complete mushroom hat and purple/lavender/silver kit. The separate ball completes the first overhead pump, chest reset and second higher drive; release at frame10/tick21 is clear of the hat and visually aligned with the extended hand.
